Hi! I'm Deacon, a second-year veterinary student from Honolulu, Hawai'i, studying in London. I upload videos for current and aspiring vet students, sharing my advice and experience getting to and through vet school. Weekly vlogs release every Sunday!

 If you want to follow my journey, subscribe to the channel and check out my Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/veterinarywithdeacon/#
